newsitem.title: FRANCE: French wheat slips despite Algerian purchase.
newsitem.headline: French wheat slips despite Algerian purchase.

text.p: French wheat slipped further on Wednesday on resale activity despite news that Algeria had bought more French wheat than it initially tendered for, dealers said.
"The overall trend remains bearish. Algeria did not help," one dealer said.
Prompt wheat into Rouen was quoted at 850 francs per tonne, and April-June delivery at 825 francs, both down five from Tuesday.
Algeria had launched a tender for 75,000 tonnes of optional soft wheat for February-March shipment but ended up buying 125,000 tonnes of French wheat.
Operators were also awaiting the results of a tender Iraq launched for the purchase of 100,000 tonnes of French wheat. Iraq has indicated it would make a decision on the tender by January 17.
But some operators said they were hoping to get news later on Wednesday.
